description: MCP server registry. Ships a .mcp.json template at <workspace.root>/.mcp.json with env-var-driven server config. Composes with agent-base:secure for credential injection. Harness-aware: deploy script translates the file path/format per target harness (Claude Code + OpenCode read .mcp.json natively; Hermes path is partial — see docs/issues/sandbox-sdk-deploy-hooks.md).
